item.title: Expansion to Portiuncula's emergency department approved
item.description: Galway County Council has given the green light for a €12 million extension to the emergency department at Portiuncula University Hospital. The 310 metre square extension will see the development of nine new patient cubicles and a gynaecology treatment room. The works also include internal refurbishment of the existing department. item.title: Calls for rate freeze in Leitrim
item.description: A Leitrim Councillor is calling for a 5 year rates freeze to be introduced for local businesses. Leitrim County Council increased commercial rates by 5% for the second consecutive year at their budget meeting last November. Sinn Féin Cllr Cormac Flynn is bringing forward a motion to next weeks council meeting, calling for a rates freeze to be put in place. item.title: Plans Due to Be Lodged for Redevelopment of Castlerea Derelict Building
item.description: Plans are due to be lodged for the redevelopment of a derelict building in Castlerea. The major project at Hanly Hall on Patrick Street will also include a large extension to the rear of the building. The Brothers of Charity services had developed plans to convert the hall into a day services or micro enterprise/office space. item.title: Leitrim's flu rates continue above national average
item.description: Flu rates in county Leitrim continue to be higher than the national average. The weekly snapshot, based on cases confirmed in a laboratory per 100,000 population in each county, are reported over a three-week rolling rate. Leitrim had a rate of 56.8 per 100,000 last week. Advertisement Counties Longford and Roscommon both recorded below the national average of 39.8 The rate in Roscommon was 31.3 per 100,000, while 17.1 per 100,000 was the figure in Longford. item.title: O'Rourke sisters to return at national championships
item.description: Castlerea World champions Aoife and Lisa O’Rourke are set to return to the ring at the national championships. The Castlerea sisters are the star attraction on Saturday January 17th in the national stadium in Dublin. Lisa O'Rourke will fight Evelyn Igharo of Clann Naofa Boxing Academy in Louth a straight final at light middleweight. The card commences from 6pm on the night. item.title: Co. Roscommon school given green light for new Astroturf pitch
item.description: A County Roscommon school has been given the go ahead for a new AstroTurf facility. Roscommon County Council has this week granted planning permission for the development at Cloonfower National School in Rooskey. The school's board of management submitted an application last November for the sports facility. The local authority gave it the green light on Tuesday subject to nine conditions. Advertisement

item.title: Carrick Councillors call for meeting with OPW Minister
item.description: Councillors in Carrick on Shannon are seeking a meeting with the OPW Minister regarding high water levels on the River Shannon. Five councillors are bringing forward a joint motion in relation the issue to next weeks Carrick on Shannon Municipal District meeting. They want a meeting with Minister Kevin 'Boxer' Moran to discuss what his plans are for the area. Fianna Fáil Cllr Paddy Farrell says some work needs to be carried out: Advertisement

item.title: Cllr calls on government to amend proposed changes to blister pack charges
item.description: A local councillor has called on the government to amend the proposed changes to blister pack charges. Leitrim Councillor Gary Prior told Shannonside FM the proposed arrangement risks significant additional costs for vulnerable patients who rely on blister packs to manage complex prescriptions safely.
